text:
Square plate about 24 cm. Estimated components:
- Green beans: ~50 g
- Zucchini: ~30 g
- Tofu/feta cubes: ~50 g
- Spinach: ~20 g
- Tomatoes: ~20 g
- Corn (two pieces): ~100 g with cob, ~60 g edible

That totals about 270 g. For energy:
- Corn: ~60 kcal
- Tofu: ~60 kcal (feta would be more)
- Vegetables: ~30 kcal
- Oil: ~5 g, ~45 kcal

That comes to about 200 kcal; I've rounded up to 220 to allow for the cubes possibly being feta and some unseen oil.

{"kcal": 220, "mass_g": 260}
